title: Architecture Rules
description: Architecture boundary rules for ground-graph-ts following clean architecture principles

rules.description: Domain layer may only import standard APIs and Zod
Application layer defines ports, use cases, errors, and transaction boundaries
Workflows may only import from application layer
Apps compose the system and may wire application and infrastructure, but not domain or workflows
Infrastructure implements application ports, never imports domain/application logic
Infrastructure packages cannot import each other directly
Domain entities must not be ORM model classes
rules.rule: Domain entities are plain TypeScript objects with Zod schemas for validation
Application port interfaces must not contain business logic

rules.description: Application layer must not import LangGraph types directly
rules.rule: LangGraph is used behind an internal adapter in workflows
